review: 701.51a: triage classed it legality/playability, but the instruction resolving and doing nothing without an Attraction deck is a resolution outcome; reclassified as mechanical/resolution, matching 701.51a-1.

701.51a-1 listed 701.51a and 701.51b under 701.51b's polarities; for 701.51a the player without an Attraction deck is the fires side. 701.51a-1 now holds 701.51a with that base, and 701.51b-1 the original scenario.

scenarios.title: A player without an Attraction deck cannot open an Attraction

setup.notes: A plays without an Attraction deck. In the has_attraction_deck variant A's Attraction deck, top first, is Kiddie Coaster (variant A, lit 2, 3, 6), Balloon Stand (variant A, lit 2, 6); the Attraction deck is not a zone the scenario format lists.

decisions: A casts Complaints Clerk, tapping four Plains.
Both players pass; Complaints Clerk resolves and its enters trigger goes on the stack.
Both players pass; the trigger resolves: A opens an Attraction.

variants.label: no_attraction_deck
variants.expected: A cannot open an Attraction: nothing enters the battlefield other than Complaints Clerk, which still resolves and enters.

variants.label: has_attraction_deck
variants.delta: A plays with an Attraction deck: Kiddie Coaster on top, then Balloon Stand.
variants.expected: Kiddie Coaster, the top card of A's Attraction deck, moves to the battlefield face up under A's control. Balloon Stand stays in the Attraction deck. Complaints Clerk is on the battlefield.

operation.unclassifiable: not a board edit: the Attraction deck is not a zone any operation edits

scenarios.forge_notes: Attraction decks need a deck file with an Attractions section; the Attraction variant (lit numbers) is chosen by the deck list.

detector.outcome: An OpenAttraction resolution puts nothing onto the battlefield: the player has no Attraction deck.
detector.near_miss: An OpenAttraction resolution puts an Attraction onto the battlefield.

setup.notes: A's Attraction deck, top first: Kiddie Coaster (variant A, lit 2, 3, 6), Balloon Stand (variant A, lit 2, 6). The Attraction deck is not a zone the scenario format lists.

decisions: A casts Complaints Clerk, tapping four Plains.

variants.label: has_attraction_deck

scenarios.title: An 'opens an Attraction' trigger fires only when the Attraction actually enters the battlefield

setup.notes: A's Attraction deck, top first: Kiddie Coaster (variant A, lit 2, 3, 6). The Attraction deck is not a zone the scenario format lists.

decisions: A casts The Most Dangerous Gamer, tapping two Swamps and two Forests.
Both players pass; The Most Dangerous Gamer resolves and its enters trigger goes on the stack.
Both players pass; the trigger resolves: A opens an Attraction. Gamer's 'whenever you open an Attraction' trigger resolves if it fired.

variants.label: attraction_enters
variants.expected: Kiddie Coaster enters the battlefield under A's control, the open-an-Attraction trigger fires, and The Most Dangerous Gamer gets a +1/+1 counter and is a 3/3.

variants.label: empty_attraction_deck
variants.expected: No Attraction enters the battlefield, so the open-an-Attraction trigger does not fire. The Most Dangerous Gamer has no counter and is a 2/2.

operation.unclassifiable: not a board edit: the Attraction deck is not a zone any operation edits

scenarios.forge_notes: The prevented/replaced-entry branch of 701.51c cannot be illustrated: no Forge card prevents or replaces an Attraction entering, so the non-entering case is shown with an empty Attraction deck.

detector.outcome: A trigger on an Attraction moving from the Attraction deck to the battlefield (an opens-an-Attraction trigger) is evaluated and fires.
detector.near_miss: The same trigger is evaluated and does not fire.
